summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Emergent Documentation System with CMS. Both backend APIs and frontend functionality are working excellently with only minor issues identified.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 for unauthorized access
minor_issues.impact: Very minor - both status codes indicate unauthorized access

minor_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /admin/login sometimes shows main page instead of login form
minor_issues.impact: Minor - login works when accessed properly through navigation
minor_issues.workaround: Login functionality works correctly when accessed through proper flow

design_observations.observation: Clean, professional documentation layout with proper responsive design
Hierarchical sidebar navigation works perfectly with proper highlighting
Real-time search with dropdown results works smoothly

passed_tests: Article CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete)
Left sidebar navigation with hierarchical structure
Main content area with rich article rendering
Article manager with filtering and sorting
Responsive design on tablet and mobile viewports
action_item_for_E1: System is working excellently! Only minor improvements needed: 1) Fix admin login routing to ensure /admin/login always shows login form, 2) Optionally standardize unauthorized API responses to use 401 instead of 403. These are very low priority issues.

performance_observations.admin_operations: Quick response times for CRUD operations
